name: 渎神牌局
detailed_description:
"FalseGod's Gambit" is a ​​Roguelike deck-building game (DBG)​​ infused with our unique creative vision, set against a rich ​​Norse mythology backdrop​​. Play as ​​Rod​​, a hardened veteran soldier undertaking his ​​final mission before discharge​​. Uncover the truth and battle your way through a deadly game woven from ​​unknown conspiracies​​ and lurking dangers!

We will follow Rode's perspective as he enters Frey Town, ravaged by the energy storm. The storm has plunged the small town into utter chaos; darkness has spread everywhere, and unusual transformations are occurring.

Mysterious forces have invaded; conspiracy, monsters, puzzles, treasures—everything awaits your exploration.

We will follow Rode's perspective as he enters Frege Town, ravaged by the energy storm. The storm has plunged the small town into utter chaos; darkness has spread everywhere, and unusual transformations are occurring. Rode's arrival will influence the final outcome.

Mysterious forces have invaded; conspiracy, monsters, puzzles, treasures—everything awaits Rode to explore.

Game Features:​​

​​Multiple Deck Options:​​ You can choose different professions for Rode to start the game. Construct your deck by leveraging the unique characteristics of each profession!

​​Card Construction:​​ Explore the town and Rode will discover hundreds of distinctive cards. Through ingenious deck building, unleash extraordinary power to take down formidable foes!

​​Regions & Divinations:​​ We've created a unique "Divinations" system for regions. By placing Divinations in an area, Rode can alter its properties—for example: unlocking additional demon events, gaining more gold after battles, or discovering extra exploration zones. Divinations offer limitless possibilities!

​​Quests:​​ During his exploration, Rode will inevitably encounter troubled individuals. He can choose to accept their commissions, initiating long-form quest events. This provides him with diverse event experiences and richer rewards!

​​Glyphs:​​ Obtaining Glyphs will grant Rode significant and lasting enhancements. A crucial Glyph could tip the scales of victory! However, acquiring them always seems to come at a cost... perhaps even an unbearable one!

Soundtrack: We've teamed up with a professional audio team to deliver players a truly distinctive soundtrack and immersive sound effects experience!​

We're delighted to finally share our game with you all!​. Building upon contemporary Roguelike card games, we've forged ​​distinctive mechanics​​ including ​​Zone Exploration​​, ​​Quest Systems​​, and ​​Prophecy gameplay​​—eagerly awaiting you to experience them firsthand.

Targeting a ​​Q4 2025 launch​​ (possibly sooner), we'll soon ​​unveil a playtest demo​​ followed by ​​public demo trials​​.

​​Thank you for your enthusiastic support!​
